description: Get project metadata: active framework plugins, discovered source files, and detected entry points. Useful for understanding how fallow sees the project before running analysis. Supports performance tuning (no_cache, threads).

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

boundaries.description: Include discovered architecture boundary zones in the response.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

entry_points.description: Include entry-point patterns in the response.

files.description: Include discovered source files in the response.

plugins.description: Include active framework plugins in the response.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

name: project_info
